findings.description: AC-4 claims invoke methods including cancelSidebarTreeLoad are mapped at preload.js L130-178. However, cancelSidebarTreeLoad is at L56 (interleaved among the listener/on* methods section), not in the L130-178 range. The method exists and is correctly characterised as an ipcRenderer.invoke call. The broad VE-1 evidence range (L1-184) covers it correctly. Only the AC-4 narrow line range (L130-178) is inaccurate.
